title: The lagna lord is exalted, in moolatrikona or in its own sign

text.en: The lord of the lagna is dignified, traditionally a sign of strong constitution and resilience.
text.impact: A robust constitution. You tend to bounce back from illness and strain faster than most people do.

title: The lagna lord is debilitated or in the 6th, 8th or 12th house

text.en: The lord of the lagna is debilitated or in a dusthana, traditionally a sign to build and protect one's constitution deliberately.
text.impact: Your constitution asks to be built up rather than spent. Regular rest, food and moderate exercise repay you more here than in most charts.

title: Periods traditionally marked for extra care

text.en: Dashas and bhuktis of the 6th and 8th lords are traditionally times to look after health with extra care: rest, routine and regular check-ups.
text.impact: These are the stretches when the tradition advises extra care: keep to your routines, rest properly and have regular check-ups. They are times for attention, not for alarm.

title: Saturn is exalted, in moolatrikona or in its own sign

text.impact: Saturn, the significator of a long life, is strong here. Endurance and steady habits come naturally to you.
